name: solstice-architecture-manifest
purpose: Machine-enforceable canonical architecture. This is not a build-status document.

packages.notes: Clock types currently import UtcInstant from packages/domain. That edge is a known layering exception.
openAccount requires VerifiedExecutionAuthority from packages/permissions. That creates a known cycle.
Canonical cryptographic control plane. Chunk 33R adds CryptoSuite registry, Ed25519, PQ ports. No vendor KMS SDK. Key metadata is not key material. Not quantum-proof.
Canonical Solstice Identity domain. Authoritative actor capabilities and ActorContext. No live KYC vendor.
Application facade for packages/identity. Not a second identity model.
Canonical VersionedEvent envelope, taxonomy, outbox/inbox abstractions. Not a second event model.
PostgreSQL adapter behind existing Ledger, Evidence Vault, and store ports. Not a second ledger. Persists security key metadata only.
Application facade for the kernel compliance screening fabric. Not a second Kernel, policy engine, or Evidence Vault.
Simulation FX quotes, beneficiaries, corridors, routing, settlement, reconciliation, and simulated rail adapters. No live rails.
Canonical simulated card issuing and processing. No live PAN vault, network, or issuer SDK.
Application facade that wires cards to canonical banking holds. Not a second card model.
Personal Economic Graph. Non-authoritative read-intelligence layer. Does not post journals or issue Execution Authority.
Application facade for the Personal Economic Graph. Not a second graph model.
Personal Economy Agent. Proposal-only. Must not depend on packages/platform, ledger, or Kernel issuance.
Canonical Growth Orchestrator and mandate compiler. Does not execute money movement or issue Execution Authority.
Canonical treasury, liquidity, corridor prefunding, deterministic routing intelligence, and settlement-risk engine. Simulation only. Not a second ledger.
Application facade for packages/treasury. Not a second treasury model.

Canonical investment account profile, paper orders, positions, lots, valuation, and reconciliation. Simulation only. Reuses canonical Account classes. Not a second ledger. Pre-trade Risk is required before paper execution.
Regulatory Digital Twin. Simulation/counterfactual layer over the existing policy engine. Never issues Execution Authority or posts journals. Not a second Kernel or policy store.
Application facade for packages/investments. Not a second portfolio, brokerage, or trading model.
Deterministic investment/portfolio Risk Engine. Supplies facts to the existing Kernel Risk proof. Never issues Execution Authority or posts journals.
Canonical model registry for deterministic/quantitative/AI models. Simulation approval only. No LIVE_APPROVED. Models cannot self-approve.
Canonical Strategy Lab. Safe DSL, reproducible backtests, walk-forward, shadow, and Risk-gated paper strategy execution. No live trading. Does not call PaperBroker or post journals.
Application facade for packages/strategy-lab. Not a second backtester, broker, or live trading engine.
Agentic Capital Mesh. Capital-intelligence and proposal system. Reuses the Personal Economy Agent runtime boundary. Cannot issue Execution Authority, post journals, or submit broker orders.
Canonical Personal Data Vault. Subject-bound encrypted store. Simulation only. Consent decisions come from packages/consent via DataUseAuthorizationPort. Not a Clean Room, marketplace, or Reyn Coin.
Canonical Consent Ledger, Purpose Registry, Purpose Firewall, and short-lived DataUsePermits. Not a financial ledger and not Execution Authority. Simulation only. Not GDPR/CCPA/PDPL legal approval.

Canonical Privacy Clean Room. Computation-to-data. Reuses Consent, Purpose Firewall, DataUsePermit, Personal Data Vault. No arbitrary SQL/code, no raw-row export, no Execution Authority, no financial journals, no SunRey Coin issuance. Simulation only. Not GDPR/CCPA/PDPL/HIPAA/DP/TEE compliance.

Canonical SunRey Coin simulation economic ledger. Extends the existing Ledger with AssetQuantity. No second ledger. No public ticker. No SunRey Exchange or SunRey Chain. Agents cannot mint. Simulation only.

Canonical Human Information Network marketplace foundation. Public brand SunRey Exchange. Sells permission, proof, and computation — not raw people-data. Personal Oracle is a module here. Do not implement the Exchange matching engine or SunRey Chain.

Canonical SunRey Chain trust, provenance, permission, attestation, policy, and settlement-anchor layer, plus the Chunk 32R transaction protocol. Simulation only. Not the financial source of truth. Canonical ledger remains authoritative. No live RPC or production network. Validator lifecycle remains PLANNED. See chunk-36-stop.md.
Canonical SunRey Exchange simulation matching, holds, clearing, and settlement. Journals stay on the canonical Ledger via CoinPort/FiatPort. No live exchange. No second ledger. Agents cannot execute.
Provider-neutral digital-asset custody control plane. Simulation adapters only. Provider state is operational, not customer-accounting truth. Canonical Ledger remains the ledger. No private keys.
Deterministic market-surveillance alerts and restriction proposals. Cannot freeze balances, issue Execution Authority, or mutate the ledger. Reuses canonical compliance cases.

components.name: Jurisdiction policy engine
components.notes: Extends the existing Compliance Kernel. Data packs plus a typed evaluator. Not a second Kernel.

components.name: AML sanctions and fraud control fabric
components.notes: Provider-neutral screening, AML profiles, transaction monitoring, fraud, velocity, and cases. Simulation adapters only.

components.name: Architecture linting
components.notes: Companion invariant scripts live under scripts/. Do not add a second linter system.

components.name: PostgreSQL persistence adapter
components.notes: Durable adapter only. Journals still post through Ledger.postJournal. Evidence still seals through EvidenceVault.

components.name: Solstice Identity
components.notes: Authoritative actor capabilities and ActorContext. Simulation WebAuthn adapter only.

components.name: Canonical bank rail adapter framework
components.notes: Simulation connectivity only. Adapters must not post journals or issue Execution Authority.

components.name: Canonical card platform
components.notes: One canonical card model. Processor adapters cannot post journals or issue Execution Authority.

components.name: Personal Economic Graph
components.notes: First SFF 2.0 intelligence layer. Non-authoritative. Does not execute.

components.name: Personal Economy Agent
components.notes: Interprets language and explains plans. Not an ActionIntent. Cannot execute.

components.name: Growth Orchestrator
components.notes: Machine-verifiable mandates and explainable GrowthPlans. Does not execute.

components.name: Canonical treasury platform
components.notes: One Treasury model. Customer balances stay on the canonical ledger.

components.name: Canonical investment account and portfolio core
components.notes: One Investments model. Brokerage cash and securities reuse canonical Account classes. Paper/simulation only. Pre-trade Risk is required.

components.name: Canonical investment risk engine
components.notes: One Risk Engine. Does not replace the Kernel Risk proof. Simulation/engineering limits only.

components.name: Canonical model registry
components.notes: One Model Registry. Hash-addressable artifacts. No in-place overwrite. No LIVE_APPROVED.

components.name: Strategy Lab
components.notes: One Strategy Lab. Safe DSL and reproducible simulation only. No live trading authority.

components.name: Agentic Capital Mesh
components.notes: One Agentic Capital Mesh. Proposes and critiques capital allocations. Deterministic control systems gate everything consequential.

components.name: Regulatory Digital Twin
components.notes: Counterfactual simulation over the existing Kernel/policy engine. Never issues Execution Authority.

components.name: Personal Data Vault
components.notes: Subject-bound encrypted personal data store. Not a financial asset, Clean Room, marketplace, or Reyn Coin. Consent is owned by packages/consent.

components.name: Consent Ledger and Purpose Firewall
components.notes: One Consent bounded context. Append-only authorization history. Purpose Firewall defaults DENY. Not a financial ledger.

components.name: Privacy Clean Room
components.notes: One Privacy Clean Room. Consent-gated constrained computation. Raw rows default DENY. Not a second Consent, PDV, Evidence Vault, or crypto system.

components.name: SunRey Coin simulation economic ledger
components.notes: One SunRey Coin owner. Journals stay on the canonical Ledger. AssetQuantity lives in packages/money. Do not invent a ticker. Do not implement Exchange or Chain here.

components.name: Human Information Network marketplace foundation
components.notes: One information-market owner. Historical reservation was PYRAMID_DATA_EXCHANGE. Public brand is SunRey Exchange. Personal Oracle lives in this package. Not a matching engine, CLOB, or chain.

components.name: SunRey Chain trust-layer foundation
components.notes: One SunRey Chain owner. Append-only simulation receipts and anchors. Not a second ledger, wallet, exchange, or live network. Settlement anchors happen after canonical ledger transfers. Chunk 31 freezes production architecture (ADR-0016–ADR-0033) without implementing a production node. Chunk 37 implements a development Tendermint-class ConsensusEngine at packages/sunrey-chain/rust/crates/consensus. Runtime/storage/P2P/validators remain internal modules, not competing packages. Chunk 36 validator lifecycle is PLANNED. See chunk-36-stop.md. Production consensus is not implemented.

components.name: SunRey Exchange simulation core
components.notes: One SunRey Exchange owner. Simulation matching and DVP settlement only. Public ticker is NOT_ASSIGNED. Do not implement Travel Rule or live exchange here.

Simulation orchestration, beneficiaries, corridors, routing, settlement, reconciliation, and simulated rail adapters. Live rails are not implemented.
Simulation FX quotes use exact rational rates. No live liquidity provider.
Simulation card platform including wallet provisioning and SoftPOS orchestration. No real issuing, PAN vault, 3DS, Apple/Google certification, or acquiring license.

Canonical model registry. Simulation approval only. No LIVE_APPROVED. Models cannot self-approve or overwrite artifacts in place.

Implemented at packages/agentic-capital-mesh by Chunk 21R. Proposal-and-critique only. Do not create competing trading-agents / investment-agents / hedge-agent / capital-ai / autonomous-trader packages. Historical stop: chunk-21-stop.md.

Canonical Strategy Lab. Safe DSL, reproducible backtests, walk-forward, shadow, and Risk-gated paper execution. No LIVE stage. Do not create packages/backtest, packages/trading-lab, packages/quant, or packages/strategy-v2.
Subject-bound encrypted Personal Data Vault. Simulation connectors only. Not legal ownership, GDPR/CCPA compliance, Clean Room, marketplace, or Reyn Coin. Consent is packages/consent.
Canonical Consent Ledger and Purpose Firewall at packages/consent. Append-only authorization history. Not a financial ledger. Not GDPR/CCPA/PDPL legal approval. Clean Room is IMPLEMENTED.

Canonical market-surveillance subsystem at packages/market-surveillance. Alerts are not legal conclusions. Cannot mutate the ledger. Reuse packages/kernel/src/compliance cases. Do not create surveillance-v2.
